description: Defines interfaces and implementation for managing the list of QUIC streams that are write blocked, including static and non-static streams, with priority handling and batch write support.

classes.name: QuicWriteBlockedListInterface
classes.description: Abstract interface for managing a list of write-blocked QUIC streams with priority handling.

classes.name: QuicWriteBlockedList
classes.description: Default implementation of QuicWriteBlockedListInterface, managing static and non-static streams, priorities, and batch writes.

classes.name: StaticStreamCollection
classes.description: Manages a collection of static streams, tracking registration and blocked state.

methods.name: HasWriteBlockedDataStreams
methods.description: Checks if there are any write-blocked data streams.

methods.name: NumBlockedSpecialStreams
methods.description: Returns the number of blocked static (special) streams.

methods.name: NumBlockedStreams
methods.description: Returns total number of blocked streams including static and non-static.

methods.name: ShouldYield
methods.description: Determines if the stream with given ID should yield based on priority.

methods.name: GetPriorityOfStream
methods.description: Retrieves the priority of a specific stream.

methods.name: PopFront
methods.description: Pops the highest priority stream, with special handling for static streams.

methods.name: RegisterStream
methods.description: Registers a stream with specified priority and static status.

methods.name: UpdateStreamPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of a stream; not for static streams.

methods.name: UpdateBytesForStream
methods.description: Updates the byte count for a stream (deprecated feature).

methods.name: AddStream
methods.description: Adds a stream to the list for its priority level, with static stream handling.

methods.name: IsStreamBlocked
methods.description: Checks if a stream is write blocked.
